name: Net Margin After Fixed Costs
description: Calculate net margin dollars after covering fixed costs, given price, cost, and volume.
formula: Net margin = (Price − Cost) × Volume − Fixed costs
business_contexts: a manufacturer assessing net profitability of a product line after overhead
a retailer assessing net margin of a store after fixed operating costs
a software company assessing net margin of a product after fixed hosting and support costs
a restaurant assessing net margin after rent and fixed labor
a distributor assessing net margin of a contract after fixed warehousing costs
question_patterns: Given the price, cost, volume, and fixed costs below, what is the net margin?
Calculate net margin after fixed costs, using the figures given.
What is the net margin, in dollars, once fixed costs are covered, given the figures below?
Calculate the net margin remaining after fixed costs are subtracted from gross margin.
Using the price, cost, volume, and fixed costs shown, what is the net margin?
solution_logic: Step 1: Calculate per-unit margin = price − cost
Step 2: Calculate gross margin = per-unit margin × volume
Step 3: Calculate net margin = gross margin − fixed_costs
key_insight: Gross margin only tells half the story — fixed costs have to come out before you know whether volume actually clears the bar.
common_mistakes: Reporting gross margin (before fixed costs) as if it were net margin
Subtracting fixed costs per unit instead of subtracting the total fixed cost once from the total gross margin
framework_soundbite: Gross margin minus fixed costs, once — not per unit, and not skipped.
